descriptions.fprintf: newlib fprintf: formats the variable arguments to the stream with the vfprintf routine at 0x802f06c8.
descriptions.printf: newlib printf: sets stdout's reentrancy pointer and formats the variable arguments to stdout with vfprintf.
descriptions.sprintf: newlib sprintf: formats the variable arguments into str through a stack string FILE with INT_MAX space, then terminates it.
descriptions.vsprintf: newlib vsprintf: formats an argument list into str through a stack string FILE with INT_MAX space, then terminates it.
descriptions.vsnprintf: SN vsnprintf: formats into str with size bytes of space, terminates it and returns -1 when the result is longer than size.
